## Changes since `v0.7.2-beta.8`

### Features

- let a tab or shell keep an AI agent's logo: the logos of Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and pi showed only while the agent ran, so a tab kept for one agent lost its logo between sessions; the icon picker now offers them in a group of their own, each bringing its color when picked, and a tab or shell that picks one shows it always, whichever agent runs and even with agent logos turned off, as its own choice wins over the running agent's ([3be45dd5](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/3be45dd5da422e7a56dca18a71cabb3a17746895))
- show shells' and tools' logos on tabs: bash, zsh, Git Bash and nu tabs showed generic glyphs, so they now show the Bash, Zsh, Git and Nushell logos in their brand colors, and the icon picker gains a group of 25 shell, platform, language and service logos, such as Docker, Python, Kubernetes and PostgreSQL, which bring their brand color when picked and take any color after; the logos come from Simple Icons 16.36.0 and share one drawing with the agent logos; PowerShell and Windows are missing there, fish's logo is GPL and Rust's and Neovim's are CC BY-SA, so those keep their glyphs or are left out; Bash's MIT notice and Git's CC BY 3.0 attribution join the open source licenses in the About dialog ([73a358dc](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/73a358dc6d08a71dee5960ec306c21bdbb917de8))
- show the logo of the AI agent running in a tab: while Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or pi runs, its tab shows the agent's logo in place of the shell's or host's icon, so tabs whose titles are cut short, renamed or alike still tell which agent each holds; the agent tracker now follows which agent runs, from its first report until it ends or the prompt comes back, since an idle agent between turns is still running; an icon chosen for the tab itself still wins, and its color tints the logo; Claude Code's logo keeps its orange while the others take the text color; a switch under Tab icons turns it off, and the logos come from Simple Icons, OpenAI's from 15.22.0, the last to carry it ([c03910cb](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/c03910cbe1e5a846d8f17dc5c61e56467e39452d))
- search the settings: a field in the settings header finds settings by their title or description in the current language, each result naming its page, and the results take the page's place while the field has text; the arrow keys and Enter pick one, Esc clears the search before it closes the dialog, and opening a result goes to its page, scrolls the setting into view and briefly tints its card and colors its title; pages that are not open are not rendered, so settingsSearchIndex.ts lists each page's settings by their i18n keys, and a test checks that both languages have every key ([1d7caab4](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/1d7caab4798c45c8c429a69e496a23ab26c0e821))
- open SFTP files with a program picked for them, ask before quitting with changes not uploaded, and show large files downloading: the file menu's Open With lists the applications macOS offers for the file with their icons, or shows Windows' own Open With dialog, or asks for a program elsewhere; a quit now names the opened files whose saved changes never reached the server, alongside running tunnels; and a file over 1 MiB downloads through the transfer engine, so it shows in the transfer list with its progress and can be cancelled ([cfc35949](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/cfc3594909280e8696b3b88953677085c34de7b9))
- open SFTP files in programs on this computer: a remote file could only be edited in tTerm's own editor; the file menu now opens it in the external editor or its default program, the way WinSCP and FileZilla do. The file is downloaded to a private folder of its own, the copy is looked at once a second, and each save that differs from the server is uploaded, after asking or at once as the settings say, written in place so the file keeps its owner, mode and symlink. An upload stops to ask when the file changed on the server since it was opened, types the system would run open only in a picked program, and the drawer lists the open files with their state ([877a4b56](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/877a4b56fc7c171ebdc437357f5b300e2eef703d))

### Fixes

- keep the menu of files open in other programs inside the window: it hung right-aligned under its button, 26rem wide, so in a narrow SFTP pane it ran past the window's left edge and the pane clipped it; it now goes to the body with a fixed place under the button, moved along to stay in the window ([0e90e1ba](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/0e90e1ba531b8780d32f09b168ff94b9d803953b))
- build the tests on Windows again: the jump-session tests against a real sshd were gated on tests alone, but the test sshd they start exists only on Unix, so the Windows test build failed to find it; they are now gated on Unix as the other real-sshd tests are ([1022cb62](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/1022cb62b0e8a167d83cb3d8ffb04cd1244cb447))

### UI and usability

- show each agent's logo in its AI agent integration row: every row showed the same plug icon, so Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and pi looked alike until their names were read; each row now draws the logo its tab shows while the agent runs, in the same colors, both in Settings and in the dialog for an SSH server ([ec211458](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/ec211458158e3ff14cc6c09d3a7c574602d72c62))
- frame the setting a search result opens, and mark the chosen result in the focus color: a tint and a colored title were too faint to find on the page, so a rounded frame in the focus color shows around the setting and fades; it sits beside the page rather than in its scroll area, which starts right at its content on some pages and crowded the frame onto the icon and title, follows the setting while the page scrolls to it, is cut to the page so it never covers the sidebar or header, and leaves the focus where it was; the chosen result in the settings search and the new tab launcher takes a border in the focus color over a light tint, as muted gray was too dark to see ([92860516](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/92860516640b53e4b917c92d868579751c5f811f))
- show focus and selection without heavy frames: text fields, text boxes and dropdowns drew a 3px halo around a border that also turned the ring color, so a focused field showed two frames, as the broadcast panel found; they now show focus with their border alone, as do the sudo prompt patterns box, the terminal theme picker and the shortcut recorder, which tints itself while recording instead of adding a halo; the theme in use tints its whole card instead of outlining the part left of its buttons, the language in use trades its outline for the tint, the cursor style and agent badge choices soften theirs, and the new tab launcher marks its row in muted gray, as the accent is a saturated color in some themes ([7eac57a2](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/7eac57a2fc3b591b9954bd7e67b01a9d4bef7f62))
- shorten the toasts that stayed longer than they needed: the uploaded note after a save in another program now goes after 1 second instead of 2, the connection test's success after 1.5 instead of 2.5, and the notes offering to reconnect tabs on an old profile or to save a quick connection after 5 instead of 10, since the timer already pauses while the pointer is on a toast ([51c89916](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/51c8991693aeacc9afdd6ad387aa7b2f373ea7d1))
- make the notes a save in another program raises smaller: they come with every save, and two lines with the remote path stood out too much; they are now one line, the question carries the amber of the files button's count, and the uploaded note goes after 2 seconds ([fa1355a0](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/fa1355a0d633ddfc5237cc32b0c1645dded53494))
- give plain toasts the popover color: they used the page background, which is the terminal's, so a toast over the terminal blended into it and was hard to tell for a message ([49392ac2](https://github.com/330079598/tTerm/commit/49392ac25558160afbec70225df09c011562f63d))
